sonnet.problem: The story card says Ezekiel "has been mute" right before card 4 asks what the LORD opens (mouth, eyes or ears). Muteness points straight to "mouth" and rules out "eyes" and "ears," so it gives away the answer to the next choice card.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The question puts God's prediction in the present tense: "Those in the ruins fall by the sword, and those in the open field go to wild animals." Verse 27 says they "will fall" and "I will give." The question tells a prediction as if it were already happening.
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
